title: An Effective Temporal Localization Method with Multi-View 3D Action Recognition for Untrimmed Naturalistic Driving Videos
venue: 2022 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW)

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Specifically, a 3D action recognition based on X3D (Expanding 3D) architecture with multi-view processing is employed for spatial and short temporal correlations.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Then, simple post-processing based on data-driven is presented for long temporal correlation in untrimmed videos.

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: Specifically, most recent state-of-the-art models rely on complex end-to-end architectures with large-scale dataset to train temporal localization models, which make those systems are difficult to be applied in practical.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Specifically, most recent state-of-the-art models rely on complex end-to-end architectures with large-scale dataset to train temporal localization models, which make those systems are difficult to be applied in practical.

methods.name: Pretraining, Pseudo-Labeling, and Data Generation
methods.evidence_sentence: The proposed method is evaluated on the AI City Challenge 2022 dataset for Naturalistic Driving Action Recognition.
